ids = ["hF31","hF2","hM1A","hF57","hF44","hF23","hF50","hF3","hF28"]
pred = {i:(0 if i in ("hF3","hF28") else 1) for i in ids}   # from Figure S6A regimen drug colors (red=resistant -> predict no benefit)
truth = {i:(1 if i in ("hF31","hF2","hM1A","hF57","hF44","hF23") else 0) for i in ids}  # bar past dashed median-PFS line
acc = sum(pred[i]==truth[i] for i in ids)/len(ids)
print("accuracy", acc, "n", len(ids))

# cross-check prediction against workbook fills (red = resistant) for regimen drugs
rows = get_rows('supp.xlsx','Chemo ')
drugcol = {'GEM':1,'PAC':2,'SN38':3,'5FU':4,'OXA':5}
regimen = {'hF31':['GEM','PAC'],'hF2':['GEM','SN38','5FU'],'hM1A':['SN38','5FU','OXA'],
           'hF57':['GEM','PAC'],'hF44':['SN38','5FU','OXA'],'hF23':['GEM','PAC'],
           'hF50':['5FU'],'hF3':['5FU','OXA'],'hF28':['GEM','5FU']}
rowof = {r[0]:i for i,r in enumerate(rows)}
for i in ids:
    r = rowof[i]; reds=[]; blues=[]
    for d in regimen[i]:
        ref = cell_ref('supp.xlsx','Chemo ', r+1, drugcol[d]+1)
        st = styles.get(ref, {})
        rgb = (st or {}).get('resolved_rgb')
        if rgb=='FF0000': reds.append(d)
        elif rgb in ('4472C4','0070C0'): blues.append(d)
    print(i, 'resistant-in-regimen:', reds, 'sensitive-in-regimen:', blues, 'pred_benefit:', pred[i], 'truth_long:', truth[i])

recs = [{"id":i,
         "score":{"ref":"vision/%s_pred"%i,"map":{"predict_benefit":1,"predict_no_benefit":0}},
         "truth":{"ref":"vision/%s"%i,"map":{"PFS_above_median":1,"PFS_below_median":0}}} for i in ids]
